description: Vary: * — the cache cannot reuse the stored entry; the second request is a fresh fetch.
notes: RFC 9111 §4.1: Vary: * must never be reused. The proxy stores nothing and reports BYPASS for every proxied request; that BYPASS is compliant and exempt from the §8.9 variant leg (ADR-004). Spec §11.3 says 'second request MISS'; the honest §5.3 label is BYPASS (MISS requires an entry to be created, and none is), and the verdict is PASS_OBSERVED either way.
